title: OCTA survey shows 'narrowing' gap between Duterte and Robredo's 2028 presidential numbers
summary: The gap of Vice President Sara Duterte and Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo's scores in a hypothetical 2028 presidential matchup is "narrowing," a recent survey from OCTA Research Group suggested.
